setup.description: Install and verify cachix, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

version.description: Expected Cachix version from the configured nixpkgs registry entry; latest accepts the packaged version. An explicit version mismatch fails setup.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

cache.description: Cachix cache name to enable with cachix use after installation; omit for CLI-only setup. Public caches need no token; private caches use inherited CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN.
